name: 19960 · Lincoln, DE
findings: ZIP 19960 (Lincoln) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19960 (Lincoln) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19960 (Lincoln) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
